meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把项目里每个源文件完整读一遍,大文件用 Read 工具的 offset 和 limit 参数分页读,从而在动手前先了解整个代码库。
howto.when: 当你要开始一个新项目或不熟悉的项目,或者你提到「learn the codebase」「read the codebase」「prime」等说法时,它会接管。

say.note: Claude 会逐个完整读取源文件

say.text: 用 learn the codebase 先熟悉这个项目
say.note: 动手前先把所有源文件读完

say.text: 我接手了一个不熟悉的项目,先熟悉下代码
say.note: 先建立对代码库的整体了解

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads every source file in the project in full, paging through large files with the Read tool's offset and limit parameters, so it understands the codebase before working on it.
howto.when_en: Use it when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you ask to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

say_en.note: Claude reads every source file in full

say_en.text: Read the codebase before we start
say_en.note: It pages through large files with offset and limit

say_en.text: I just picked up an unfamiliar project — prime it
say_en.note: Builds overall understanding before any edits
